description: Learn-ILT kit blocks — pre-built, pre-animated, on-brand sub-composition scenes. PREFER a kit block over a hand-authored archetype whenever a beat matches one: a block ships a finished, brand-correct, seek-safe timeline, so it removes the hand-authoring that produced flat, small-type, out-of-sync beats. If no block fits a genuinely bespoke layout, the builder authors that one scene by hand from the foundation. Every block is built on templates/blocks/_foundation.css (one token contract, one cqw type scale, four grounds via #root[data-ground], shared primitives). To use one: copy templates/blocks/<id>.html into <project>/scenes/, edit its CONFIG object, set data-ground on #root, add it to scenes.json. File name = data-composition-id = window.__timelines key = <id>.
naming: <category>-<variant>. category = scene archetype; variant = style. Categories: stat, chart, list, diagram, lower-third, title, section, code, callout, media. Reserved: quote.

grounds.content-wash: default — warm paper wash, ink text. Most content beats.
grounds.hero-swoosh: warm sweep — title / opening / closing only.
grounds.dark-field: navy, WHITE ink (auto-inverted) — the dramatic exception, at most one scene.

blocks.summary: Opening title card: kicker + big two-line title + subtitle + accent rule, waterfall entrance.
blocks.content_shape: The video's title, or a closing/major divider — one headline statement that owns the frame.
blocks.best_for: Opener, closer, top-of-video title, major act break.
blocks.avoid_when: The beat teaches content, peers, steps, or data — that is a content block, not a title.

blocks.summary: Numbered segment divider: big section number + vertical accent divider + title + one-line description.
blocks.content_shape: A transition between major parts of the video, labeled with a number and a section title.
blocks.avoid_when: It is the video's title (use title-hero) or an actual content beat.

blocks.summary: Big single count-up figure with label + caption.
blocks.content_shape: One headline number that impresses by its magnitude.
blocks.best_for: A single total, scale, or reach figure on the light ground.
blocks.avoid_when: The number is dramatic enough to carry a whole beat (use stat-spotlight) or it tracks toward a target (use stat-progress).

blocks.summary: Count-up numeral + accent progress track filling to value/max, with label + caption.
blocks.content_shape: One metric progressing toward a goal or ceiling.
blocks.best_for: Adoption %, completion toward a target, progress against a max.
blocks.avoid_when: There is no target/ceiling — a bare figure is stat-count.

blocks.summary: The dramatic single-stat beat on the dark ground: huge white count-up + glow + accent underline. The 'WOW'.
blocks.content_shape: One number that deserves the entire frame, in negative space, for impact.
blocks.best_for: The video's most impressive metric — used at most once, as the dramatic exception.
blocks.avoid_when: You have already spent the dark-field scene, or the number is routine (use stat-count).

blocks.summary: Animated bar chart with a secondary trend line drawing on; headline + legend.
blocks.content_shape: Values compared across categories, plus one overlaid trend or conversion line.
blocks.best_for: Monthly/quarterly magnitudes, before/after bars, a count with a rate line.
blocks.avoid_when: Only a trend matters with no categories (use chart-line) or there is one number (use a stat block).
blocks.config: headline, subtitle, bar data, line data, legend

blocks.summary: Dual-line trend chart drawing on, with dots, value labels, legend, x-labels.
blocks.content_shape: Two series changing over an ordered sequence.
blocks.best_for: Growth trends, two-metric comparison over time.
blocks.avoid_when: Categories not time carry the meaning (use chart-bar).

blocks.summary: Labeled spec rows (label + value) with accent underline rules, staggered reveal.
blocks.content_shape: A set of attributes expressed as label/value pairs.
blocks.best_for: Module specs, config values, at-a-glance fact sheets.
blocks.avoid_when: The rows are ordered steps (use list-steps) or peers being chosen among (catalog archetype).

blocks.summary: Numbered process steps: accent number badges + connector line + title/detail, top-to-bottom stagger.
blocks.best_for: Setup sequences, how-to procedures, ordered workflows.
blocks.avoid_when: The items are unordered attributes (use list-specs) or a branching decision (use diagram-flow).

blocks.summary: Decision-tree flowchart: white nodes + blue connectors + emphasis node + 'You' cursor, node-then-connector reveal.
blocks.content_shape: Branching decision logic or a chosen path through options.
blocks.best_for: If/then decisions, choose-a-branch logic, a walked decision path.
blocks.avoid_when: A linear sequence (use list-steps) or an architecture graph (blueprint archetype).
blocks.config: nodes + edges + the emphasized decision + chosen branch

blocks.summary: Light IDE window: filename chip + muted semantic syntax + line numbers + active-line highlight, line-by-line reveal.
blocks.content_shape: A short code snippet the learner should read.
blocks.best_for: Dev content — API/CLI/SDK examples, a config file, a short function.
blocks.avoid_when: The idea is conceptual, not literal code.
blocks.config: filename, language label, code lines, active line

blocks.summary: Learn-style key-point card: accent tab + glyph + label + term + body, panel scale-in with tab wipe.
blocks.content_shape: One takeaway, definition, or note to emphasize.
blocks.best_for: KEY POINT, NOTE, DEFINITION, a single emphasized fact.
blocks.avoid_when: The content is a list, a stat, or a full beat of explanation.

blocks.summary: A still screenshot in a neutral browser window, with a slow Ken Burns push and an optional accent callout box over a region.
blocks.content_shape: A single portal/app screenshot the learner should look at, optionally with one region highlighted.
blocks.best_for: Portal/admin-center stills, a settings blade, a result screen, any UI the narration points at.
blocks.avoid_when: The action needs to be seen happening (use media-screen-recording), or it is a code file (use code-window).
blocks.config: src (project-local png in assets/media/), url label, caption, callout region {x,y,w,h} in %

blocks.summary: A screen recording that PLAYS in a neutral browser window (framework-owned video), with a REC indicator and caption.
blocks.content_shape: A short screen-capture demo the learner should watch happen.
blocks.best_for: Portal walkthroughs, click-throughs, demos, a change shown in motion.
blocks.avoid_when: A single still makes the point (use media-screenshot); a long-form demo that IS the whole video (that is the demo-walkthrough profile, not one beat).
blocks.config: src (project-local mp4 in assets/media/), duration (= scene length), url label, caption

blocks.summary: Name/role overlay card: white panel + accent tab + name + role, wipe-in.
blocks.content_shape: A brief identifier overlaid on another scene — a speaker, tool, or term.
blocks.best_for: Introduce a person, product, or term as a lower-third overlay.
blocks.avoid_when: It is a full-frame beat, not an overlay.

blocks.summary: Peer rows cascade in; a count reads up; ONE row lifts with an accent tab as the rest recede.
blocks.content_shape: A small set of peer items with one selected, compared, or emphasized — a choose-one decision.
blocks.best_for: Roles, assignment/policy types, app categories, options, inventory — lifting the one that resolves the scenario.
blocks.avoid_when: Order, containment, causality, or dependencies carry the meaning (use list-steps, diagram-layers, or diagram-flow); or nothing is selected (use list-specs).

blocks.summary: Concentric labelled planes settle outside-in around a protected core that glows last.
blocks.content_shape: Nested scopes, boundaries, inheritance, or protection arranged outside-in around a core.
blocks.best_for: Containment, trust boundaries, layered security, inheritance, management scope.
blocks.avoid_when: The items are peers (use list-select), the explanation is a sequence (use list-steps), or relationships/links matter more than nesting (use diagram-flow).

blocks.summary: Portal-like status panel: check rows populate, then the blocking row flips pending→passed.
blocks.content_shape: Operational details expressed as checks, statuses, approvals, or pass/fail outcomes.
blocks.best_for: Readiness checks, approval flows, troubleshooting checks, request detail, pass-or-fail status.
blocks.avoid_when: The beat is conceptual or relational (use diagram-flow), a sequence (use list-steps), or a plain peer list (use list-select).
